usedFor: Grist holds the records, and Razorpay receives an invoice through “Create Invoice” when “New Record” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in Grist, then “Create Invoice” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: The action takes customer details, line items and an optional due date, so one row can supply them.

watchOut: “Updated Record” also starts “Create Invoice”, so editing a row could raise a second invoice.
